en.dir.title: Housekeepers · Handymen
en.dir.emptyHint: Know a good housekeeper or handyman? Send them this page to list themselves.
en.page.how.title: How it works
en.page.how.body: Housekeepers, handymen and other home workers list themselves with a form. The Mot Dang team checks each listing before it goes on the site. People who want to hire contact them by the LINE or phone they gave, and agree the work and the pay between themselves. The person listed can change or remove the listing with the private link they get after sending the form.
en.legal.notEmployer: Mot Dang is the notice board. The person hiring and the worker contact each other and agree terms directly.
